latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of text-to-video-generation skill.
- Instantly turn text prompts (TXT, DOCX, PDF, or pasted text, up to 500MB) into AI-generated 1080p videos with visuals and background music.
- Designed for rapid, no-editing video creation—just describe what you want and receive an MP4 for download.
- Handles session management, uploads, credits, and exports automatically via API (no user setup required).
- Full support for common text, audio, and video workflows, including status queries, file uploads, and export in various formats.
- Smart error handling and clear, non-technical user feedback for seamless experience.
